questions.a: You're welcome to visit our showroom and take one of our test-drive-ready models for a spin.

questions.q: How do I book a service appointment?
questions.a: Call 7777-8090 to book a service appointment.

questions.q: How long does a service take?
questions.a: It depends on the type of service, diagnostic results, and parts availability. Your service advisor will give you an estimated timeframe in advance.

questions.q: Can I get a repair quote in advance?
questions.a: Yes. After the initial inspection and diagnostics, we'll present the work to be done, parts needed, and total cost. If additional work is required, we'll proceed only after getting your approval.

questions.q: How do I order genuine parts?
questions.a: Provide your vehicle's VIN and the part details needed, and we'll check pricing and availability for you.

questions.q: Can I order a part that's out of stock?
questions.a: Yes. You can pre-order, and our parts staff will let you know the expected delivery timeframe.

questions.q: What are the advantages of genuine parts?
questions.a: Using parts of unclear origin can negatively affect your vehicle's other components and performance, make repairs ineffective, and wear out faster — so you should install genuine, warrantied parts supplied by the official manufacturer.

questions.q: When is the VAT refund paid?
questions.a: After registering your purchase's e-receipt in the e-receipt app, the refund is paid starting the 20th of the quarter following the month it was verified.

questions.q: What warranty comes with a new vehicle?
questions.a: Toyota provides free repair for any defect arising under normal use — except items listed under 'Not Covered by Warranty Repair' — for 3 years or 100,000 km, whichever comes first.

questions.q: What comes included with a new vehicle?
questions.a: New vehicles come with 6 complimentary oil service packages and 3 engine air filter replacements.

questions.q: What are the requirements for Toyota-Q?
questions.a: Vehicles manufactured within the last 7 years, driven under 100,000 km, and purchased from an official dealer are eligible.
